items.title: G7 将在特朗普威胁后释放数百万桶石油和柴油
items.original_title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
items.summary_zh: 据 BBC 报道，七国集团将协调释放数百万桶石油和柴油，旨在遏制价格进一步飙升，并避免美国实施柴油出口禁令。
items.summary_en: The G7 is set to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel in a co-ordinated move aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 协调释放战略储备与柴油出口政策将直接影响全球能源价格和通胀预期。
items.why_it_matters_en: The co-ordinated release could shape global energy prices and inflation expectations amid supply and trade tensions.

items.title: 普京警告西方：俄罗斯准备使用一切武器保护加里宁格勒
items.original_title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
items.summary_zh: 普京警告西方，俄罗斯准备使用一切武器保护加里宁格勒，同时坚称莫斯科“没有威胁任何人”，只是在回应西方国家表态。
items.summary_en: Putin warned the West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad, while insisting Moscow is “not threatening anyone” and is merely responding to Western statements.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 加里宁格勒是俄罗斯与北约之间的敏感前沿，相关言论升级可能增加误判风险。
items.why_it_matters_en: Kaliningrad is a sensitive NATO-Russia flashpoint, and escalatory rhetoric raises the risk of miscalculation.

items.title: 基辅市长警告：俄军加强打击正撕裂基辅
items.original_title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
items.summary_zh: 基辅市长克利奇科称，俄罗斯对关键基础设施的打击使乌克兰首都处于“非常戏剧性”的局面。
items.summary_en: Kyiv Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko said Ukraine’s capital is in a “very dramatic situation” as Russia strikes critical infrastructure.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 冬季前对能源和基础设施的持续打击可能加剧乌克兰人道与能源危机。
items.why_it_matters_en: Sustained strikes on critical infrastructure before winter could deepen Ukraine’s humanitarian and energy crisis.

items.title: 埃塞俄比亚与厄立特里亚因北部冲突升级断绝外交关系
items.original_title: Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties as northern conflict escalates
items.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚与厄立特里亚宣布断绝外交关系。与此同时，埃塞俄比亚政府军正在北部地区与叛军交战，冲突持续升级。
items.summary_en: Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties as Ethiopian forces battle rebel fighters across the country’s northern region.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 非洲之角对抗升级可能把更多地区力量卷入，增加区域战争风险。
items.why_it_matters_en: The diplomatic fallout raises fears of a wider regional war in the Horn of Africa.

items.title: 英伟达启动 1500 亿美元股票回购计划
items.summary_zh: 英伟达启动 1500 亿美元股票回购计划，报道称这是美国企业史上规模最大的回购。该公司继续凭借其在 AI 供应链顶端的优势地位获取巨额利润。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这一回购规模反映 AI 芯片龙头的现金流实力，并可能影响科技股与 AI 投资周期。

items.title: 中国占全球集装箱出口比重飙升至 40%
items.summary_zh: 中国欧盟商会称，中国占全球集装箱出口比重快速升至 40%，突显中国经济对贸易的依赖，也引发贸易伙伴对竞争压力和产能问题的担忧。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该比重变化是全球贸易格局和中国出口依赖度的重要指标。

items.title: OpenAI 因敏感信息处理不当解雇员工，安全团队再受关注
items.original_title: OpenAI fires workers for 'mishandling sensitive information'
items.summary_zh: BBC 报道，OpenAI 解雇数名员工，内部调查指其处理敏感信息不当，包括与外部 AI 评估组织共享数据。事件加大外界对 AI 安全团队与保密边界的关注。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has fired employees after an internal investigation into mishandling sensitive information, including sharing data with an outside AI evaluation group, the BBC reported.
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI 公司如何平衡外部安全评估与商业机密，正成为治理和信任焦点。
items.why_it_matters_en: The case highlights the governance tension between external AI safety evaluation and corporate confidentiality.

items.title: 苹果收紧 macOS 全盘访问权限，应对 AI 代理风险
items.original_title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
items.summary_zh: 苹果表示将收紧 macOS“全盘访问”权限控制，并警告能力日益增强的 AI 代理使应用广泛访问用户文件、信息、邮件和浏览记录的风险上升。
items.summary_en: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail and browsing history riskier.
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI 代理普及正推动操作系统重新设计权限与隐私边界。
items.why_it_matters_en: The change signals how AI agents are forcing operating systems to rethink permission and privacy boundaries.

items.title: 美法官驳回针对谷歌 AI Overviews 的反垄断诉讼
items.original_title: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google’s AI Overviews
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦法官驳回 Chegg 和 Penske Media 对谷歌 AI Overviews 的两起反垄断诉讼。该诉讼指控谷歌 AI 搜索功能造成网络流量流失，但法官站在谷歌一边。
items.summary_en: A federal judge dismissed antitrust lawsuits from Chegg and Penske Media accusing Google’s AI-powered search features of driving away web traffic.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 判决将影响 AI 搜索与内容出版商之间利益冲突的监管走向。
items.why_it_matters_en: The ruling matters for how regulators and courts treat AI search features that disrupt publishers’ traffic.

items.title: 中国出台房贷贴息政策
items.summary_zh: 中国政府将为首次购房者提供支持，并下调一项央行放贷利率，作为提振经济增长的最新举措。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 房地产与信贷支持是中国稳增长和稳定市场预期的关键工具。

items.title: 油价跌回每桶 98 美元，沙特有望重启管道
items.summary_zh: 油价从每桶 109.97 美元回落至 98 美元。此前一系列无人机袭击破坏东西向输油管道，沙特关闭该管道近两周后有望重启。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 能源供应中断与恢复继续主导全球通胀和地缘风险定价。

items.title: 西班牙首相桑切斯在住房危机关键投票中失利
items.original_title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
items.summary_zh: 西班牙首相桑切斯在一项住房危机关键投票中失利。此前一名 87 岁女性被驱逐引发众怒，这加大了他提前举行大选的压力。
items.summary_en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez lost a key housing crisis vote after the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, raising pressure on him to call a snap election.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 住房危机正在演变为西班牙政治稳定风险，并可能触发提前选举。
items.why_it_matters_en: The housing crisis is becoming a political stability risk for Spain and could trigger early elections.

items.title: 法国教育抗议持续，防暴警察与学生冲突
items.original_title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
items.summary_zh: 法国教育抗议持续，约 735 所学校受到影响。防暴警察与学生发生冲突，抗议焦点是教育标准和教师短缺。
items.summary_en: About 735 schools faced disruption as violent protests over education standards and a lack of teachers continued in France, with riot police clashing with students.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 教育与社会不满可能进一步冲击法国政府议程和政治稳定。
items.why_it_matters_en: Education and social grievances could further complicate the French government’s agenda and political stability.

items.title: 吉利汽车发布充电时间不到 5 分钟的电池
items.summary_zh: 吉利汽车称其超快充系统仅需 4 分 30 秒即可将电池电量从 10% 充至 70%。此举凸显中国车企寻求降低成本并减少对宁德时代电池的依赖。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 快充与电池自主化将影响中国电动车企业的全球竞争力。

items.title: 中国 8 月对美稀土出口下滑
items.summary_zh: 中国 8 月对美稀土出口下滑。报道称，稀土供应预计将成为中美领导人华盛顿峰会上的交锋点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 稀土是中美科技、贸易与供应链博弈中的关键筹码。

items.title: 澳大利亚监管警告 Steam、Roblox 等平台存在儿童安全重大缺口
items.original_title: Australia says platforms like Steam and Roblox have 'significant' child safety gaps
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚在线安全监管机构称，Steam、Roblox、Fortnite 和 Minecraft 等平台在儿童安全方面存在“重大”缺口，并要求其改进。
items.summary_en: Australia’s online safety regulator said platforms including Steam, Roblox, Fortnite and Minecraft have “significant” child safety gaps and told them to “lift their game.”
items.why_it_matters_zh: 游戏与社交平台正面临更严格的未成年人保护监管。
items.why_it_matters_en: Gaming and social platforms face tighter regulatory scrutiny over child protection.

items.title: OpenAI 推出 Dots 代理平台，定位企业软件
items.original_title: OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出名为 Dots 的新代理平台，整体体验更像企业办公软件，但也能完成订餐等日常任务。
items.summary_en: OpenAI’s new agent platform, Dots, feels very much like workplace software that happens to be able to order you a burrito.
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI 代理产品正从演示走向企业工作流和日常任务。
items.why_it_matters_en: AI agent products are moving from demos into enterprise workflows and everyday tasks.

items.title: Meta 开源代码，让开发者制作 Muse AI 硬件
items.original_title: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
items.summary_zh: Meta 开源代码，允许开发者制作搭载其新 AI 代理 Muse 的硬件设备，例如彩色电子墨水提醒屏或 HDMI 电视棒。
items.summary_en: Meta now lets developers build their own Muse gadgets, including projects like loading Muse on a color E Ink display or an HDMI stick.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开源硬件生态可能加速 AI 代理进入家庭设备和消费电子。
items.why_it_matters_en: An open hardware ecosystem could accelerate AI agents’ entry into home devices and consumer electronics.

items.title: 谷歌推出 Guided Vision，用 Gemini Live 实时描述周围环境
items.original_title: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
items.summary_zh: 谷歌在 Gemini Live 中推出 Guided Vision，可在兼容 Android 设备上通过摄像头实时提供音频描述，帮助阅读小字、识别物体和描述周围环境。
items.summary_en: Guided Vision is launching in Gemini Live on compatible Android devices to give real-time audio descriptions of anything the camera is pointed at.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态 AI 正进入无障碍辅助与日常视觉理解场景。
items.why_it_matters_en: Multimodal AI is moving into accessibility and everyday visual assistance.

items.title: 亚马逊警告社区不要阻止 AI 数据中心项目
items.original_title: Amazon writes scary blog warning communities not to block data centers
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊 AWS CEO 马特·加曼发文警告，社区若阻止 AI 数据中心项目，可能对美国经济与国家安全造成不可逆伤害。文章同时回应就业、电力需求和环境影响等公共担忧。
items.summary_en: Amazon is calling for support for AI data center projects, warning of irreparable harm to the US economy and national security in a blog by AWS CEO Matt Garman.
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI 基础设施扩张与地方能源、土地和就业矛盾正在加剧。
items.why_it_matters_en: The push highlights growing tensions between AI infrastructure expansion and local concerns over power, land and jobs.

items.title: 中国因 AI 能源需求加快核聚变探索
items.summary_zh: 中国正大力投资小型模块化反应堆，同时将研发力量投向被称为“能源圣杯”的核聚变技术，部分动力来自 AI 能源需求。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI 算力需求正推动能源技术竞争，并影响长期电力供应格局。

items.title: Circuit Breaker Labs 希望让 AI 对儿童和成人更安全
items.original_title: Circuit Breaker Labs hopes to make AI safer for your kids (and you)
items.summary_zh: Circuit Breaker Labs 推出“碰撞测试假人”式工具，试图降低 AI 对用户尤其是儿童的心理伤害。报道称，已有一些人受到 AI 的心理影响。
items.summary_en: Circuit Breaker Labs has created “crash-test dummies” to make AI safer for children and adults, aiming to reduce psychological harm.
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI 安全正从模型能力扩展到用户心理与社会影响。
items.why_it_matters_en: AI safety is expanding from model capability to psychological and social harm.
